title: leucanthemum praecox var. alpicola
intro: Leucanthemum praecox var. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family. The Alpine Daisy has been used in traditional medicine to support digestive health and reduce inflammation due to its various health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help protect the body against oxidative stress, infection, and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of the Alpine Daisy include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
